content.text: short-acting beta-agonists (typically albuterol) are the cornerstone of drug therapy; an MDI used correctly works as well as a nebulizer.

BBs block the effect and can cause severe bronchospasm in asthma (cardioselective only, w caution, if ⍉alt). Loop/thiazide diuretics: hypokalemia and ECG chgs can worsen. Digoxin levels may fall; consider monitoring. MAOIs/TCAs (or w.in 2 wks of stopping): extreme caution, vasc effects potentiated.

excess β stim (seizures, angina, HTN or hypotension, tachy up to 200/min, arrhythmias, tremor, hyperglycemia, hypokalemia, met acidosis); ♡ arrest and death are poss. Tx: stop the drug, Sxtomatic care; a cardioselective BB may be considered judiciously (it can cause bronchospasm).
